statement: Cross-partition JOIN execution pushes the join table's own WHERE sub-predicates, the required column projection, and a join-key filter into the per-partition join-table SQL instead of fetching SELECT * with no filter; the cosmetic BROADCAST/REPARTITION strategy split is either realized as genuinely different execution or collapsed to one honest strategy; guard tests prove reduced join-table row transfer and unchanged join results against real per-partition SQL execution.
